packages.angle: Bitcoin succeeds regardless of politics because its price cycles are emotional and its value is a free-market escape from government money.

segments.label: hook
segments.text: Bitcoin imposes a global free market for the first time ever.

segments.label: clip_01
segments.text: I mean, the good news about Bitcoin is it's not, you know, its success is not dependent upon who's in the White House or who's controlling the Senate or the House of Representatives in the U.S. You know, price -wise, some people would say when it's when it's persecuted and when it's in the crosshairs, it tends to do pretty well.

segments.label: clip_02
segments.text: When Bitcoin and an asset is going up and the bull market is super hot, everyone loves it. When the bear market is happening and Bitcoin is going down, everyone hates it. And like, that's why the price got high and that's why the price got low, because everyone loved it at the top and everyone wanted exposure and everyone hated it and didn't want exposure at the bottom.

bridges: The lesson is that Bitcoin's survival is a story of human emotion and free choice, not institutional permission.

angles.angle: Bitcoin is the most undervalued asset because it offers a free-market escape from government money while the dollar loses purchasing power.
Bitcoin succeeds regardless of politics because its price cycles are emotional and its value is a free-market escape from government money.
Bitcoin will power a new internet of abundance by ending the government money monopoly and outperforming the debased dollar.

takeaways.text: Politics may shape the noise around Bitcoin, but its deeper appeal and wild mood swings come from people seeking an exit from state-controlled money.
The lesson is that Bitcoin's survival is a story of human emotion and free choice, not institutional permission.
